rows.note: Finds what Home remembers when you ask.

rows.label: Speech to text
rows.note: Turns what you say into words, on this computer.

rows.note: Home's spoken voice.

rows.label: Edit pictures tools
rows.note: Remove a background, erase something, make a picture bigger.

rows.label: Look at pictures
rows.note: Name household objects, wall colour and light. Runs only when Home sends a picture.

rows.label: Split songs into stems (HTDemucs)
rows.note: Separates songs made in Home into vocals, drums, bass and other. Recommended, about 0.3 GB.

rows.label: Finer stem splitter (HTDemucs fine-tuned)
rows.note: An optional four model package for finer stem separation.

rows.label: Six-part stem splitter (guitar and piano)
rows.note: An optional model that separates guitar and piano too.

rows.label: Time song lyrics (MMS aligner)
rows.note: Finds when each word of a song's lyrics is sung, for the lyrics display. Optional, about 1.3 GB.

rows.label: Change the singing voice (SoulX-Singer)
rows.note: Converts a vocal toward a reference voice. Optional, about 3 GB.

rows.label: Recorded speech (Fish Audio Drama 3)
rows.note: Makes a finished voice recording from typed words, including dialogue. Optional, about 24 GB; needs a 64 GB or larger computer.

rows.label: Search helper
rows.note: Looks up web search results for adults, when web search is turned on.
